
### Install
1. Download **Satori.zip** below, unzip it, and drag **Satori.app** to Applications.
2. Open it. The first time, macOS can't verify the developer: go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and
   click **Open Anyway**. It isn't notarized, so macOS asks once.
   If it still won't open: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Satori.app`

Requires macOS 14 or later. Runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
